about_the_game:
Hop into the legendary Black Cab! The LEVC TX 2 has arrived in Barcelona, and with its unique style, unrivalled comfort and elegant British touch, it is sure to stand out on the streets of the city.

World-famous for its unique design and iconic silhouette, the LEVC TX 2 embodies the timeless elegance of urban transport in London. With its sturdy construction, refined finish and instantly recognisable look, this electric vehicle takes your experience of driving through the sunlit streets of Barcelona to a whole new level.

Behind the wheel, you’ll benefit from:
• Precise handling, ideal for negotiating the narrow alleys of the city centre or bypassing Barcelona's traffic jams.
• A spacious, refined interior, ensuring premium comfort for your passengers, whether they are VIP tourists or locals in a hurry.
• An accurate representation: the LEVC TX 2 model is officially licensed, so it has been recreated with an attention to detail that is true to reality.
